feature: Skip affordance during the map lead-in and breaks (shell lazer-parity phase B)

upstream_sources.role: Overlay visibility window (progress > 0 while currentTime < startTime - MINIMUM_SKIP_TIME) and expiry when no skippable window exists
MINIMUM_SKIP_TIME = 1000; Skip() guard (no-op past the window) and skipTarget = GameplayStartTime - MINIMUM_SKIP_TIME
Ported test intent: TestSkipTimeZero/TestSkipTimeEqualToSkip (no window -> affordance never appears), TestClickOnlyActuatesOnce (single actuation, retired after the jump)

ported_assertions.no_window_never_appears: TestSceneSkipOverlay.TestSkipTimeZero/TestSkipTimeEqualToSkip -> product-ui skip.spec 'no skip affordance when the first object time equals the skip lead' and controller guard test 'skip is refused outside skippable windows'
ported_assertions.single_actuation: TestSceneSkipOverlay.TestClickOnlyActuatesOnce -> repeated skip() after a jump is a refusal; node tests assert the anchor and committed time move exactly once
ported_assertions.skip_target: MasterGameplayClockContainer.Skip skipTarget = GameplayStartTime - MINIMUM_SKIP_TIME -> SKIP_LEAD_MS = 1000; target = next boundary - lead (lead-in: first object; break: break end), clamped to >= committed + 1 ms

classifications.divergence: The affordance is a DOM button outside the canvas input surface (lazer overlays the playfield); ours additionally offers skip during beatmap breaks (lazer's intro SkipOverlay does not), targeting one lead before the break end; skip is a clock re-anchor, not lazer's GameplayClockContainer.Seek
classifications.input_policy: Inputs received before the skip are submitted at their pre-skip receipt times; residual records stamped with the closed clock epoch are dropped and fail loudly if replayed - an explicit policy, not a hidden clamp
classifications.not_executed_upstream: No pinned upstream test executes against this implementation (display-side behavior; the SkipOverlay scene is a visual test). The pinned sources above were read at the manifest commit and their assertions ported locally, so this is intent-level evidence, not upstream acceptance
classifications.remaining: Upstream acceptance for the skip window remains open pending a reference-host adapter comparable to the pause suite; no acceptance IDs are attached

reproduce: npm --prefix platform/browser-js test && npm --prefix platform/product-ui run test:browser -- tests/browser/skip.spec.mjs
